newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS BRUSH SPLIT ASIDE, BARCELONA ALSO WIN.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS BRUSH SPLIT ASIDE, BARCELONA ALSO WIN.

text.p: Champions Panathinaikos brushed aside Split 72-50 on Wednesday in a EuroLeague basketball group C match.
The Croats lacked power under the boards, succeeding with only three out of 18 triples and failing to score for eight minutes in the second half.

American John Amaechi with 17 points lifted the Greeks to their second group C win of the season, but last year's beaten finalists Barcelona are a point clear with three wins out of four after beating bottom club Bayer Leverkusen 90-71.
Unheralded Villeurbanne are on the same number of points at the top after a narrow 70-69 victory over Ljubljana.
But it was a the closest of close-run things for the team from the suburbs of Lyon, who were without injured Americans Ronnie Smith and Brian Howard.
The referee awarded two consecutive missed penalties with only a few seconds left and a last gasp throw from Slovenian winger Tusek rolled round the basket before going out.

Villeurbanne, trailing 35-43 at halftime despite good periods, scraped a victory they hardly deserved thanks to American Delaney Rudd who scored a spectacular three points with 64 seconds left as the Slovenians led 69-64 and then struck twice more.
